svg.title: F15-1 Generator plant of one MSC-1 building: 17 sets on a split 20 kV generator bus
svg.text: F15-1 Generator plant of one MSC-1 building: 17 sets on a split 20 kV generator bus
17 x 3.6 MVA / 2.88 MW at 0.8 pf · 103.9 A per set at 20 kV · N = 16 for 43.92 MW facility load, +1 redundant · section A 9 sets, section B 8 sets · bus-coupler 52BC normally closed
• 17 x 2.88 MW = 48.96 MW installed against 43.92 MW facility load: with one set out, 16 x 2.88 = 46.08 MW still covers the load.
• Every 52G closes only through the device 25 window (0.1 Hz, 3 %, 10° in the example setting sheet); the dead-bus close is allowed for one set only.
